none: PAS FindID 984572: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), probably issue of 317-330, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust helmeted left with round shield on left shoulder. Obverse inscription: [--]TANTINVS MAX AVG. Reverse description: Horseman walking left, arms akimbo and brandishing long spear, small kneeling figure to left. Reverse inscription: possibly erased, along with mintmark. Diameter: 21.2mm, Weight: 3.69gms, die axis: 6
